stem: What is meant by solution and percentage of solution?
keyPoints: ["Solution: homogeneous mixture of solute and solvent","Percentage: solute amount relative to solution amount × 100"]
modelAnswer: A solution is a homogeneous mixture in which a solute dissolves in a solvent. Percentage of solution expresses the amount of solute relative to the specified amount of solution, commonly as (amount of solute ÷ amount of solution) × 100.

stem: Define solubility; effect of temperature with graph.
keyPoints: ["Definition of solubility","Some solutes increase in solubility with temperature","Some solutes decrease in solubility with temperature"]
modelAnswer: Solubility is the maximum amount of solute that dissolves in a specified amount of solvent at a specific temperature. Temperature can change solubility: KCl and NH4Cl increase in solubility as temperature rises, whereas Na2SO4 and Ca(OH)2 decrease. A graph plots solubility against temperature and shows the relevant upward or downward trend.

modelAnswer: A colloid is a heterogeneous mixture with particles about 1–1000 nm that remain dispersed and can show the Tyndall effect; milk is an example. A suspension has undissolved particles larger than 1000 nm that can be seen and settle; muddy water is an example.
